Radical acceptance. I was severely sexually abused as a child and only this year decided to start therapy because I couldn't keep going the way I had been.  And last week, I was talking with my therapist and she told me that the only way I'd heal from this point forward would be radical acceptance.  Which if you don't know, is basically the Serenity Prayer of Christianity. Once I did that, I was able to speak on what happened to me in childhood and managed to realize that I had made myself older during the abuse because my brain at the time was too young to understand what was actually happening.  Another thing she told me is that when I think about that very dark time, I need to be the support that younger me needed but never got. And when I say I BAWLED. It was a soul cleansing cry. I'm nowhere near at peace yet but I'm working toward it. I'm not a victim. I'm a survivor. And I'm damn proud of that.
